doctrine: Funding floors for the SIP-WH-01 wallet_funding_depletion watch. Floors are OPERATIONAL MINIMUMS in native units: enough to keep the wallet's role functional (priority hops, anchor ceremonies, standby readiness) without a top-up. A balance below floor triggers a medium PredictiveAlert naming wallet label + rail only (Rule 8) and a top-up checklist. NEVER automated funding. Floors are forward-only like every ledger-tied artifact: recalibration is a new version with a disclosed reason.

BTC Writer (MCR/Satoshi Track).basis: 3+ priority 0x12 hops at ~3,000 sats each incl. fees

Stellar Writer B.basis: standby reserve parity with Writer A

XRP Writer B.basis: standby reserve parity with Writer A

AVAX Writer.basis: ~20 zero-value calldata anchors at dynamic gas

DOT Writer B.basis: existential deposit; 10.02 DOT inbound per roster

SOL Writer A.basis: ~10,000 memo v2 txns of rent+fee headroom

ATOM Writer Mainnet.basis: ~20 memo legs at up to 25k gas

DOGE Writer.basis: ~200 OP_RETURN legs at 0.25-1 DOGE dust tolerance

ETH Writer.basis: ~10 zero-value calldata anchors at type-2 gas

XFER-1 Receive Wallet.basis: test_complete receive-only role; monitored watch-only, no depletion trigger
